typography.notes: Ensure tight tracking on headings (-0.02em) and generous line-height on body text. DO NOT USE INTER OR ROBOTO.

colors.strategy: High-Contrast Technical. Deep Midnight Indigo base with sharp Blurple/Indigo primary accents. Flat solid surfaces with crisp 1px borders.

layouts.app_shell: flex h-screen overflow-hidden bg-background. Sidebar on the left (w-64 shrink-0). Main content flex-1 overflow-y-auto. Desktop optimized.
layouts.sidebar: Fixed, border-r border-border bg-card/50, full height. Links should have generous padding py-3 px-4 rounded-md. Active state must have a high-contrast indicator.
layouts.ingest_page: Grid layout: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8 p-8. Left: Large Textarea h-[60vh] with subtle focus ring. Right: AI Suggestion Card displaying editable parsed fields.
layouts.pipeline_page: Horizontal scrollable flex container for Kanban stages (p-8). Columns w-80 shrink-0 flex flex-col gap-4. Card-based deals.
layouts.health_dashboard: Bento Grid: 3 summary metric cards (col-span-1), 1 large chart card for Rep Leaderboard (col-span-3 or full width) using Recharts.
layouts.deal_detail: Two-column layout (p-8): Deal Info/Metadata (Left w-1/3) & Activity Timeline (Right w-2/3).

visual_enhancers.cards: Flat solid background, 1px border-border, subtle shadow-sm. Avoid heavy rounded corners (use max 8px). On hover: shadow-md -translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-200.
visual_enhancers.status_dots: Use colored circles w-3 h-3 rounded-full. Green (Healthy), Yellow (Warning), Red (Stale). Add animate-pulse to Red dots.
visual_enhancers.ai_elements: The AI Suggestion card should have a subtle glowing border or a slight primary-tinted background to distinguish it from static data.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast on hover.

components.icons: lucide-react. Prefer clean, technical icons. NO emojis.
components.charts: Recharts for the Health Dashboard bar chart. Ensure charts use theme variables (hsl(var(--primary))) for bars.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use high-contrast for primary actions.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing: All buttons, inputs, links, and cards MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a B2B SaaS dashboard tool (PipelineGuard). Follow standard technical UI layout principles.
Install 'recharts' for the Health Dashboard visualization.
Update tailwind.config.js and index.css with the provided CSS variables to override Shadcn's default theme with the custom High-Contrast Midnight Indigo theme.
Include Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' in index.html and apply them in index.css.
Build a persistent Sidebar navigation component (4 links: Ingest, Pipeline, Health, Deal Detail).

On the Ingest Page, build a two-pane split: Textarea for raw input (left), and an AI Suggestion Card displaying editable mapped fields (Deal Stage, Next Step, Stakeholders, Sentiment) with an 'Accept Changes' CTA (right).
On the Pipeline Page, build a Kanban board with 3-4 columns (e.g., Lead, Qualified, Proposal, Closed). Each deal card MUST feature a freshness indicator dot (Green, Yellow, or Red).
On the Health Dashboard Page, display 3 stat cards (e.g., Total Pipeline, At-Risk Deals, Hygiene Score) and a Bar Chart using Recharts showing Hygiene Score by Rep.
On the Deal Detail Page, design an activity timeline component showing past interactions (newest first).
DO NOT use generic centered App layouts. Remove any text-align: center from global CSS.
Apply specific hover interactions (e.g., transform, box-shadow) on Kanban cards and primary buttons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific properties (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease) to prevent breaking transforms.
Never center-align the main app container. Maintain a left-aligned data-heavy SaaS layout.
Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside major layout panels and containers.
Add a data-testid attribute to all key interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs).
Do NOT use AI assistant emojis for icons. Use lucide-react icons exclusively.
Ensure dark colors are used independently without blending them into generic background gradients.
